_note: Cinematics (CinematicsPage.tsx): the Godot build's list (dev_state.json). Play runs cinematic <id>.RoQ, which plays the upscaled video/<id>.ogv (pak_oz_video.pk3, cl_cin_ogv.c, P3) and the original RoQ from the player's pak0 without it. unlocked comes from the campaign's progress with P12 (all open until then). back: what runs when the movie ends (the cvar nextmap, as q3_ui's cinematics menu does): this page again, on that movie. credits: the Credits page's state (Extras, as the cinematics).

list.title: id Software
list.do: close; cmd set nextmap "{cinematics.list.0.back}"; cmd cinematic idlogo.RoQ
list.back: ui_page menu; ui_run sub extras; ui_page cinematics; ui_focus cin_idlogo
